title: v15.75 two affine verdicts
dek: Research branch only. Not merged to main. Open-state affine null confirmed. A separate CPTP channel is null only at its frozen reference. Do not merge the two verdicts.

claims.text: Primary: AFFINE_OPEN_NULL_RETAINED_CLOSED_CONFIRMED. Across twelve frozen states the retained-output tangent map has rank 36 for both pre-Sylvester skew Q and rotation E. No common nonzero retained tangent lies in both kernels. For a fixed affine law, open-state rotational nullity forces the linear part to preserve the hidden tangent sector. The finite stack is a numerical witness of the analytic statement, not a substitute for it.

Secondary: CPTP_POINTWISE_NULL_ONLY_CONFIRMED. One fixed CPTP affine channel, Phi(z)=Tr(z)I/8+.01 Tr(XXX z)Y_ref, has nonzero symmetric retained leakage and null rotation at its frozen anchor. The same channel is visible on the other eleven states. ONLY distinguishes that anchor from this ensemble. It does not say the anchor is the unique null in the full state space. The channel is a counterexample, not a source law derived from recoverability.
